{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gentry''' were the higher of the two classes that inhabited [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]]. Gentry was a self-mocking name adopted by Metellos' decandent executives. The gentry ruled the floating [[City/Legends|cities]] and upper levels of the [[stratablock]]s.
